programme: No shared programme is nameable from this list. The twelve factors split into unrelated functional groups: general chromatin/transcription machinery (BRD4 as a BET bromodomain reader, SMARCA5 as an ISWI remodeler, PCGF2 as a PRC1 Polycomb subunit, MNT as a MAX-network repressor, ZNF224 as a KRAB-zinc-finger repressor, TBPL1 as a TBP paralog), axial/sensory developmental patterning (HOXD11, ATOH7 with its retinal-fate targets POU4F2/ISL1/NEUROD1), thymic central tolerance (AIRE, whose targets are classic tissue-restricted self-antigens), mitochondrial biogenesis (NRF1, targeting TFAM/PPARGC1B/COX17/CYCS), MAPK-pathway repression (CIC), and two homeobox/EMT-adjacent factors that converge only on each other's targets (PCGF2 and LBX1 both target ZEB1). None of these groups share a downstream node, a physical complex, or a documented pathway with the others, and BRD4/SMARCA5/PCGF2/MNT/ZNF224 belong to five mechanistically distinct chromatin complexes rather than one.
role_in_a: Not established from this record: no factor in the list has any Open Targets association or retrieved literature connecting it to Cardiovascular_Disease. Even the two factors with real experimental support (BRD4, SMARCA5) have that support entirely in cervical/HPV biology, not vascular or cardiac tissue.
role_in_b: BRD4 is documented to regulate the HPV16 late promoter together with E2/ZC3H4 and to influence HPV replication and apoptosis in cervical cells (PMID 41109402, 40801544); SMARCA5 is reported to restrain metastasis in cervical cancer via a circRNA-SND1-YWHAB axis (PMID 33588586). These are two independent, disease-specific findings about individual genes, not evidence of a joint module.
shared_axis: No axis can be constructed. The cervical-cancer evidence for BRD4 and SMARCA5 is real but stays inside HPV/tumor-cell biology with no analog offered for blood or vascular tissue anywhere in the record, and the other ten factors (developmental, immune-tolerance, mitochondrial, MAPK-repressive) have no documented or mechanistically obvious link to either disease.
reasoning: Concordance counts are non-trivial (up to 64/104), but 104 patient-group comparisons come from only 2 independent cohort pairs, so this reflects within-cohort consistency across subgroup slicing, not independent replication. Combined with zero retrieved or Open Targets evidence for any factor in Cardiovascular_Disease, and a factor list too functionally heterogeneous to name one mechanism, there is nothing here to build a joint account on — this is exactly the case the incoherent verdict exists for.
support: PMID 41109402 — BRD4 role in HPV replication and apoptosis in cervical cells, disease-specific to Cervical_Cancer only. PMID 40801544 — BRD4 (with E2/ZC3H4) activates the HPV16 late promoter, disease-specific to Cervical_Cancer only. PMID 33588586 — circSMARCA5 restrains metastasis in cervical cancer via SND1/YWHAB, disease-specific to Cervical_Cancer only. PMID 42202548 — CIC transcriptomic score in immune-excluded cervical tumors, disease-specific to Cervical_Cancer only. None of these four touch Cardiovascular_Disease.
how_to_falsify: Run ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN for BRD4, SMARCA5, PCGF2, MNT, and ZNF224 in matched vascular endothelial or cardiac tissue and in cervical epithelium; if they show convergent co-occupancy at a shared gene set (e.g., a common EMT/EndMT or stress-response module) in both tissues, that would overturn the incoherent call and support a real chromatin-regulatory module. Absent that, the current record gives no basis to expect one.
caveats: Tissue pairing is blood vs. cervix — very different physiology, and the record shows no factor bridging them. Only 2 independent cohort pairs underlie the 104 'patient-group comparisons,' so recurrence fractions overstate independent replication. The tissue-generic exclusion list removed exactly the factors (NFATC1, RARA, BCL3, RORA, FLI1, FOS, IRF1, PBX1, TBX21, FOXO3, STAT5B) that would normally carry an inflammatory/immune cardiovascular story, which is why no such story can legitimately be built from what remains — that absence is the exclusion doing its job, not a gap to fill in.
